rate_model_note: Flat amount per plaza by local time of day (America/Denver): each band runs from 'from' until the next band starts. The same on every day of the week.
reprices_on: as announced on the page ('Pending Toll Rates')
source_note: 'Current Toll Rates. Effective May 1, 2026'. non_expresstoll is DERIVED: the base charge plus the $1.35 processing fee the fee schedule charges per transaction on every trip without an ExpressToll transponder (effective 2026-02-02). The $0.90 mailing fee is per bill and not estimated.
payment_premium_note: The page publishes one base charge; vehicles without ExpressToll add the processing fee per transaction.
